messages:
Ava (Product PM): Quick sync — need to lock Q3 hosted API scope by EOW. Main tradeoffs: embeddings unit cost vs fidelity, chat latency tail vs token-accuracy, rerank throughput for low-latency customers. I sketched three candidate bets.
Miguel (EngLead): share the bets pls
Ava (Product PM): 1) "Embeddings budget" — quantization+prefix cache + CDN for hot vectors. 2) "Enterprise SLA" — Dedicated + 99.9 SLO + audit logs. 3) "Rerank turbo" — tiny model+batched rerank path for ecom. Each has engineering cost + revenue signal.
Sam (Infra): capacity note: GPU pool currently saturated on peak by 20% for 4p model, so rerank bursts will hit queueing unless we change batching. Autoscale helps but warmup is slow.
Priya (ML Eng): quality constraints: quantization regressions visible for some semantic similarity cases. Need at least 500 synthetic eval pairs to validate per model before shipping.
Tom (Sales): customer ask: 2 pilot customers: Atlas search wants rerank latency < 120ms p95; Beacon (SaaS) wants embeddings at half current cost for large batches.
Devex (DevEx): SDK impact: embeddings cache + credentials for enterprise will need SDK hooks. Need docs + migration guide.
Ava (Product PM): Proposed launch criteria (must meet all):
``
- p95 latency for chat <= 180ms on standard tier
- embeddings cost reduction >= 40% on batch workloads
- rerank p95 <= 120ms for ecom workload in canary
- regression < 1.5% on anchor eval set (semantic sim)
- rollout plan: 3-stage canary (internal -> pilot customers -> general)
``
Miguel (EngLead): numbers look reasonable but embedding cost target 40% needs more detail — is that per-token or per-request amortized with cache?
Priya (ML Eng): per-token quant gains vary by seq-length. Suggest we target median batch in customer telemetry: seq=128.
Sam (Infra): to hit chat p95 we need KV cache warmup and per-tenant routing; otherwise tail risk persists. Estimate 2 sprint infra work.
Tom (Sales): if we can offer a "pilot discount" for Atlas/Beacon we should prioritize rerank & embeddings. They move fast and will become reference.
Devex (DevEx): we can draft migration guide in parallel but need API stability — please freeze experimental flags 1 week before canary.
Ava (Product PM): propose prioritization order: 1) Embeddings budget (fast economic win), 2) Rerank turbo (pilot commitments), 3) Enterprise SLA (longer lead). Thoughts?
Miguel (EngLead): +1 for embeddings first. Can we split work so infra+ml can ship independent deliverables? e.g., embeddings caching infra + separate quant model.
Priya (ML Eng): yes, we can parallelize: quant model + regression harness (ML), caching + routing (infra).
Sam (Infra): I'll scope the infra work: estimate 3 sprints to add tenant-aware cache + autoscale policy changes. Need budget for extra GPU headroom during pilots.
Ava (Product PM): Action items:
- Miguel: own embeddings delivery cadence (owners + sprint plan)
- Priya: eval harness + regression criteria
- Sam: infra sprint estimates + headroom ask
- Devex: docs outline + SDK hooks
- Tom: finalize pilot agreements w/ Atlas & Beacon
I'll circulate a 1-pager and OKR draft by Tue. If no objections, we'll lock scope end of week.
Miguel (EngLead): fine by me. @Priya can you push initial eval results by Wed?
Priya (ML Eng): will do. pushing sample harness today.
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting reminder set for 2095098745 (roadmap lock).
Ava (Product PM): thanks all :thumbsup:
